parsed.scene_description: The image shows a corner of a living room with a gray sectional sofa. The sofa is upholstered in a light grey fabric and has several pillows on it. On the right side of the sofa, there is a wooden coffee table with a lamp on top. In front of the couch, there are several power cords and a white power strip plugged into a socket on the wall. The floor is covered with a blue carpet. The walls are painted white and there are a few framed pictures hanging on them.
